root_idea.summary: The root has two principal semantic branches: making something firm, sound, and well-ordered; and sediment, mud, or clay. The material branch also extends to something used to improve or support an undertaking.
root_idea.development: The firmness branch yields the causative sense of making something sound or perfectly executed, as well as the description of a skilled person. The second branch concerns muddy sediment used to improve land and, more broadly, useful means or materials.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Quran-attested Form IV verb with a directly supported lexical use.

senses.definition: To make something firm, sound, thoroughly executed, and fitly fashioned or ordered; to perfect it.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence, the verb is transitive and describes making all things firm, sound, and disposed in the proper manner.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To treat or irrigate land with thick, muddy, or sediment-laden water so as to improve it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II verb used of land and the application of muddy water or water containing تِقْن.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sediment, slime, or thick mud carried by water and deposited in a stream, torrent channel, or well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The material may be used to improve land; descriptions include dark or fetid mud mixed with slime.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A resource, material, or means by which a person is supported or an affair is improved and well managed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May refer to useful materials such as iron or other substances, and more generally to anything that improves an undertaking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To exercise or possess the skill required for an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the construction أَتْقَنَ لَهُ, said of having the requisite competence for a matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make one's knowledge sound and thorough, or to master and learn a report or tradition accurately.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with knowledge or learning, including the construction أَتْقَنَ عَنْهُ for learning something thoroughly from another person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A skilled, capable, or adept person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The associated proper name or surname ابن تِقْنٍ refers to a man proverbial for exceptional skill in shooting; this is an application of the sense ‘skilled person,’ not a separate basic meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Nature, natural disposition, or an inherent quality.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a quality that belongs to a person's nature, such as eloquence being part of his disposition.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Form II land-improvement use is represented.
The unit contains the Quran-attested perfection sense and two broader Form IV constructions.
Sediment, slime, and mud sense is represented.
Resource or improving means sense is represented.
The proverbial name Ibn Tiqn is an application of the skilled-person sense.
Nature or natural-disposition sense is represented.
